candidates.source_name: Posta e Kosovës — Payment Services (Shërbimet e pagesave)
candidates.why_relevant: Posta e Kosovës is licensed by BQK as a Non-Banking Financial Institution and runs the country's largest non-bank bill-payment counter network (Kos-Giro, Treasury revenue collection, commercial biller agreements). Its service page enumerates which billers/institutions it has signed, which is the single best public map of non-bank acceptance and disbursement volume in Kosovo.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML fetch of sq/en service pages + diff to detect newly added billers/partners
queries_used: Posta e Kosovës shërbime pagesash bashkëpunim bankë

candidates.source_name: Posta e Kosovës — Procurement / Prokurimi publications
candidates.why_relevant: Tender and award notices from the post office reveal which IT/payment vendors supply its counter systems, terminals, reconciliation and postal software — supplier identification the bank-only view misses.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled crawl of the procurement listing page; download tender/award PDFs
candidates.discovered_via_method: snowball from Posta e Kosovës site
queries_used: e-prokurimi Kosovë tender sistemi i pagesave terminale POS Posta e Kosovës

candidates.source_name: e-Prokurimi — Kosovo national e-procurement platform (KRPP)
candidates.why_relevant: Mandatory portal for all public procurement notices in Kosovo. Publicly-owned adjacent buyers in this cell — Posta e Kosovës, Telekomi i Kosovës/Vala, KEK/KESCO, KOSTT, regional water companies (KRU) — must publish contract and award notices here, naming the winning payment/IT supplier and contract value. Highest-yield pointer for vendor and partnership discovery outside banks.
candidates.access_status: open browsing; registration + digital certificate required to bid
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query notice search by contracting authority (Posta, Telekomi i Kosovës, KEK, KESCO, KRU) and by CPV codes for payment terminals / IT systems; store award notices
queries_used: Kosovo e-prokurimi.rks-gov.net platforma elektronike e prokurimit publik KRPP njoftimet për kontratë

candidates.source_name: BQK — Përdorimi i kartelave në Kosovë / Korišćenje kartica na Kosovu (card usage report)
candidates.why_relevant: Central Bank statistical report on card and POS terminal usage (e.g. 17,187 POS terminals installed end-2023, ~90% contactless). Gives the denominator for acceptance-estimate work and is published in sq/sr/en, satisfying local-language coverage.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF fetch; extract POS/ATM/card tables
queries_used: osiguranje Kosovo plaćanje računa pošta banka platni terminali srpski

candidates.source_name: BQK — Institucionet Financiare të Licencuara (register of licensed financial institutions)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative actor list for this cell: microfinance institutions (IMF), non-bank financial institutions (IFJB), non-bank payment service providers (OSHP jo-bankë), e-money institutions, insurers and FX offices. Every new licence is a new buyer of core, terminal and reconciliation systems.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly fetch of the register pages; diff entity lists to detect new licences/withdrawals
queries_used: BQK institucionet financiare jo-bankare të licencuara ofruesit e shërbimeve të pagesave lista
institucionet mikrofinanciare Kosovë lista BQK IMF raport vjetor sistem bankar TI
local_language_terms_used: ofrues i shërbimeve të pagesave jo-bankë (OSHP)

candidates.source_name: BQK — Rregullore për qasjen e ofruesve të shërbimeve të pagesave jo-banka në sistemet e pagesave
candidates.why_relevant: Regulation opening interbank payment-system access to non-bank PSPs — the legal trigger that lets telcos, post, MFIs and payment agents plug directly into rails, creating new integration/vendor demand. Track for effective dates and access conditions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch PDF; monitor BQK regulations index for amendments
queries_used: BQK institucionet financiare jo-bankare të licencuara ofruesit e shërbimeve të pagesave lista
local_language_terms_used: ofrues i shërbimeve të pagesave jo-banka

candidates.source_name: BQK — Operating scheme of the Interbank Payment System (Kos-Giro)
candidates.why_relevant: Describes the national interbank clearing system and the Kos-Giro bill-payment instrument used by utilities, post offices and payment agents — the rail every adjacent buyer in this cell connects to. Defines message formats and participant categories relevant to integration vendors.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch page and linked participant lists; re-check semi-annually
queries_used: Kosovë agjent pagesash rrjet PayLink SwiftPay Kos-Giro Capital Ria pagesa faturash

candidates.source_name: Capital Ria (Capital-KS) — licensed payment institution with agent network
candidates.why_relevant: Non-bank payment institution with a wide agent network handling utility bills, all regional water companies (Prishtina, Gjakova, Hidromorava, Hidroregjioni Jugor), telecom/internet/TV bills, vehicle insurance and registration, property tax and university fees. Its biller list is effectively a directory of who has outsourced acceptance, and it is itself a buyer of agent-terminal and reconciliation software.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch payments page + agent locator; diff biller list over time; cross-check licence in BQK register
candidates.discovered_via_method: sq query on bill payment + snowball
queries_used: pagesa e faturave KEK ujësjellës Kosovë online terminale kioska
Kosovë agjent pagesash rrjet PayLink SwiftPay Kos-Giro Capital Ria pagesa faturash

candidates.source_name: VllesaPagesa — bill payment service
candidates.why_relevant: Second identified Kosovo non-bank bill-payment operator; competitor/peer to Capital Ria and a buyer of agent terminal and biller-integration technology. Site lists supported billers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic fetch of biller/service pages; verify licensing status against BQK register
queries_used: Kosovë agjent pagesash rrjet PayLink SwiftPay Kos-Giro Capital Ria pagesa faturash

candidates.source_name: Paysera Kosova
candidates.why_relevant: Foreign e-money/payment player with a Kosovo presence; LinkedIn page surfaces hiring, partnership and merchant-acquiring announcements that signal new acceptance channels for non-bank buyers.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Manual/low-volume review of public posts; prefer the company's own site for automated collection

candidates.source_name: KESCO — electricity supplier payment channels (Pagesa e energjisë elektrike / eKesco)
candidates.why_relevant: KESCO is the largest single biller in Kosovo. Its payment help pages enumerate accepted channels — counters, eKesco app with domestic and international Visa/Mastercard, direct web payment, third-party agents — identifying the acquirer/PSP behind each channel and any new acceptance partner it adds.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch payment/FAQ pages and the eKesco payment endpoint landing page; diff channel list; inspect payment page for PSP branding

candidates.source_name: KRU Prishtina — online bill payment / eKRUP
candidates.why_relevant: Largest regional water company; recently launched online invoicing and payment (eKRUP). Regional water companies (KRU Prishtina, Gjakova, Hidromorava, Hidroregjioni Jugor) are a repeatable cluster of billing-system and payment-acceptance buyers, and are also public contracting authorities on e-Prokurimi.

candidates.why_relevant: Transmission system operator publishing its own tender list and an early e-Procurement adopter (since Jan 2017). Useful as a utility-sector procurement source and a template for how Kosovo utilities publish IT/system awards.

negative_findings.description: No evidence found of a live mobile-money / e-wallet product operated by either Kosovo mobile operator (Vala/Telekomi i Kosovës or IPKO) despite explicit sq-language searching for partnerships and new payment services.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches returned operator corporate/product pages and market-structure articles only; no carrier-billing, wallet or mobile-money launch was surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell rationale assumes telco mobile money is a growth vector. If no such product exists, the telco leg of the cell is about top-up distribution, billing systems and bill-pay acceptance rather than wallets — which changes which suppliers matter.

negative_findings.description: No public disclosure found of which acquirer/PSP serves the large retail chains (Viva Fresh, Meridian Express) or the fuel networks (HIB Petrol, Petrol Company) in Kosovo.
negative_findings.result_summary: Retailer sites confirm card acceptance and 'certified platforms' in generic terms; no bank or terminal-vendor partnership was named in any result.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Merchant-acquirer linkage is the core competitive intelligence for the retail acceptance segment; it will have to be inferred from checkout-page inspection, terminal branding in store photos, or vendor case studies rather than from merchant announcements.

negative_findings.description: Hypothesised Kosovo payment-agent brand names 'PayLink' and 'SwiftPay' returned no Kosovo-specific results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only Capital Ria, VllesaPagesa, Paysera Kosova and the Kos-Giro instrument were confirmed; the two guessed brands do not appear to exist in this market.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents a fabricated actor entering the actor map; the agent-network segment appears smaller and more concentrated than assumed.

negative_findings.description: Serbian-language (sr) searching for Kosovo adjacent-buyer payment actors returned mostly Serbia-proper sources (Pošta Srbije, Serbian insurers) rather than Kosovo-based Serbian-language sources; only the BQK sr-language card report was a true hit.
negative_findings.result_summary: One usable sr source found (BQK 'Korišćenje kartica na Kosovu'); Serbian-language Kosovo actors such as MTS d.o.o. Kosovo and northern-municipality utilities were not surfaced.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Serb-majority north has parallel payment habits and its own operators/billers; leaving it uncovered biases the acceptance picture toward the Albanian-language market.

negative_findings.description: The session's web-search budget (200 calls) was exhausted before planned queries on ARBK business registry, telco payment news monitoring, and MTS Kosovo could be executed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two final planned queries returned a budget-exhausted notice instead of results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Coverage of the corporate-registry pointer and of Serbian-language telecom actors in this cell is incomplete and should be completed in a follow-up run.

coverage_gaps.description: MTS d.o.o. (Telekom Srbija's Kosovo operation) and Serb-majority northern municipality utilities/billers were not covered.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run sr-language queries for 'MTS Kosovo plaćanje', 'uplata računa sever Kosova', and check ARKEP's operator register for MTS licensing and postal operators in the north.

coverage_gaps.description: No corporate-registry pointer captured. ARBK (Agjencia e Regjistrimit të Bizneseve në Kosovë) would give ownership, shareholder and beneficial-owner data for payment agents, retail chains and fuel networks.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and add the ARBK online business-registry search endpoint as a pointer source; use it to resolve entity identity for every commercial actor in this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Only one regional water company (KRU Prishtina) was captured; the remaining KRUs named by Capital Ria (Gjakova, Hidromorava, Hidroregjioni Jugor, and others) have their own billing systems and procurement.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate all KRUs via the water regulator (ARRU/Autoriteti Rregullator për Shërbimet e Ujit) and add each utility's site plus its e-Prokurimi contracting-authority profile.

coverage_gaps.description: No vendor-side case-study sources (terminal manufacturers, switch/acquiring software, kiosk vendors publishing Kosovo references) were identified in this slice.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search vendor press rooms and integrator case-study pages for 'Kosovo' references; snowball from any supplier name appearing in e-Prokurimi award notices.

coverage_gaps.description: e-Prokurimi's notice search may require registration or a digital certificate for anything beyond basic browsing, and no fetch was attempted to confirm what is publicly readable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe the portal's public notice-search endpoints during the deterministic verification pass; if gated, fall back to KRPP publications and to contracting authorities' own procurement pages.

coverage_gaps.description: Individual MFI websites (KEP Trust, FINCA Kosovë, KRK, AFK, Besëlidhja, Kosinvest) were named via AMIK but not captured as individual sources.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add each MFI's site and careers page as separate direct sources; IT job ads and digital-lending launches are the strongest signals of a core-system or vendor change.

brief: Kosovo's non-bank acceptance and disbursement landscape is documented far better on the regulator and procurement side than by the buyers themselves: BQK's licensed-institution register, its card-usage statistics (published in sq/sr/en) and its new regulation on non-bank PSP access to payment systems, together with the mandatory e-Prokurimi portal, form the reliable backbone for this cell. The buyer layer is concentrated and identifiable — Posta e Kosovës as a BQK-licensed NBFI running the largest counter network via Kos-Giro, two mobile operators (Vala/PTK and IPKO), roughly a dozen AMIK-member MFIs, around fourteen insurers under BKS, KESCO and the regional water companies as dominant billers, and Capital Ria plus VllesaPagesa as non-bank agent networks. The weakest link is supplier attribution on the private side: no retail chain (Viva Fresh, Meridian) or fuel network (HIB Petrol, Petrol Company) names its acquirer or terminal vendor publicly, so those links must be inferred from checkout-page inspection and from e-Prokurimi award notices on the public-sector side. Serbian-language coverage of the northern market (MTS, northern utilities) and a corporate-registry pointer (ARBK) remain the two highest-priority gaps.
